<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_29" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_30"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Decree No.&#160;1,053/2018</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Following the expiration of the Public Emergency Law of 2002 in December 2017, and a few months after the implementation of the transition scheme, which included the agreement on the basic conditions for the supply of the Distribution segment, the performance of the contracts executed under the mentioned agreement was affected by a sharp devaluation of the peso in 2018 and by the decision of distributors to pay a natural gas price based on the exchange rate implicit in the tariff scheme approved for the 2018 winter period (lower than the price established under the Framework Agreement and the individual contracts). This triggered a renegotiation process of individual agreements with prices in U.S. dollars, which resulted in a reduction in the price of natural gas applicable to the October 2018 - December 2018 period, with no agreement being reached regarding the exchange rate differences to be contemplated. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;16, 2018, Decree No.&#160;1,053/2018 was published, whereby the Argentine Government decided to take over, with respect to distributors and producers who had adhered to the scheme, the payment of the accumulated daily differences on a monthly basis between the price of natural gas purchased by distributors and the price of natural gas included in the tariff schemes effective from April&#160;1, 2018 to March&#160;31, 2019, in 30 consecutive monthly installments beginning on October&#160;1, 2019. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Also, this decree established that since April&#160;1, 2019, contracts between natural gas producers and distributors shall provide that the higher cost due to exchange rate variations shall never be transferred to natural gas full-service users. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On October&#160;25, 2019, YPF adhered to the regime established under such decree, under which the Argentine Government has only paid the first installment, the remaining unpaid accrued as of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;14, 2020, Law No 27,591 was published, approving the budget for fiscal year 2021, and overruling Decree No.&#160;1,053/2018. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Company filed administrative claims with the Ministry of Economy requesting the payment of the second to the thirtieth installment under the regime plus interest and additional claims, which as of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements have not yet been resolved. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.c.2) Exports of natural gas and LNG </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Natural gas</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Under the Gas Law and its Regulatory Decree, natural gas exports shall be authorized by the PEN, to the extent domestic supply is not affected, and a natural gas export regime was established, which includes firm and interruptible authorizations. During the Public Emergency Period of 2002, Argentine authorities adopted several measures restricting natural gas exports from Argentina. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Also, since 2016, the natural gas export regime was modified by numerous successive regulations whose final purpose was to safeguard domestic market supply restricting natural gas exports. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Specifically, under former MEyMN Resolution No.&#160;104/2018 and former SGE Resolution No.&#160;9/2018, the Procedure to Obtain Natural Gas Export Licenses was established, providing that in order to obtain an export license, the domestic market supply should be secured. This procedure was later overruled by SGE Resolution No.&#160;417/2019. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">At present, natural gas exports are subject to SE Resolution No.&#160;360/2021 modified by Resolution No.&#160;774/2022, which specifies the terms and conditions of the Process to Award Licenses for the Export of Natural Gas through pipelines. Such process contemplates the firm export preference right granted under the Plan GasAr 2020-2024 and Plan GasAr 2023-2028 (see Note 36.d.1)) to producers holding export licenses. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In 2024, through the Bases Law, regulated by Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 (see Note 36.j)), natural gas exports were approved following the same terms and conditions as for liquid hydrocarbon exports as described in Note 36.a.1). </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_30" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_31"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_31" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_32"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_32" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_33"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_33" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_34"><ix:exclude>

<td colspan="5" style="vertical-align:top"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</div></div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 1pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, 2023 AND 2022</div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_34" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_35"><ix:exclude> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL">(Amounts expressed in millions of United States dollars, except shares and per shares amounts expressed in United States dollars, and as otherwise indicated) </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_35" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_36"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Regarding natural gas infrastructure, Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 established that in the case of exports that involve the construction of new natural gas pipelines or new connections to them and/or new facilities, the SE&#8217;s <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-objection</div> to the export of natural gas will not imply authorization for their construction or new natural gas pipeline connections, which will be authorized through the relevant procedures. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">LNG</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On July&#160;27, 2021, SE Resolution No.&#160;706/2021 was published, which created a registry of LNG operators and regulated export activities. In order to obtain an export permit, LNG exporters are required to register in the respective category and ensure they have offered the possibility to acquire such product to potential domestic market agents which might be interested. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The resolution mentioned above also establishes that the enforcement authority may issue firm LNG export permits for a term of up to <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:ExportPermitTerm" contextRef="P07_27_2021To07_27_2021_LNGMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="ixv-120353">20</ix:nonNumeric> years, having previously evaluated that the domestic supply of natural gas would not be affected considering the characteristics of the project and the possible impact on natural gas transportation capacity, at any stage of the production process. This permit may not be subsequently revoked or interrupted to ensure domestic market supply. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In 2024, through the Bases Law, regulated by Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 (see Note 36.j)), a special regime was established for long-term firm export authorizations for LNG export permits. The SE will have to verify the sufficiency of natural gas resources in Argentina to supply local demand and LNG export projects, and may oppose the request for export authorization, based, among others, on the lack of availability of natural gas. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In case the SE does not object to the request, it will issue a &#8220;free LNG export authorization&#8221; granting firm export rights for <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:ExportPermitTerm" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_FreeLngExportAuthorizationMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="ixv-120354">30</ix:nonNumeric> years from the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">start-up</div> of the liquefaction plant or its expansions, and may not be subject to interruptions, restrictions or redefinitions in the future, and which may be transferred to third parties if certain conditions are met. </div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.c.3) Regulatory requirements applicable to natural gas distribution </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Group participates in natural gas distribution through its subsidiary Metrogas. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The natural gas distribution system is regulated by the Gas Law, which together with its Regulatory Decree, other regulatory decrees, the Bidding Terms and Conditions, the Distribution License and the Transfer Agreement lay down the legal framework for Metrogas&#8217; activities. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Distribution License, the Transfer Agreement and the regulations issued under the Gas Law establish certain requirements regarding the quality of service, capital investments, restrictions for the transfer and encumbrance of assets, cross-ownership restrictions among producers, transporters and distributors of the natural gas, and the transfer of Metrogas&#8217; shares. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Natural gas distribution tariffs were established in the Distribution License and are regulated by the ENARGAS. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Distribution License</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Distribution License authorizes Metrogas to provide the public distribution service of natural gas for a term of <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:PublicDistributionServiceTerm" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_MetrogasMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="ixv-120355">35</ix:nonNumeric> years, renewable upon expiration, on December&#160;28, 2027, for an additional term of <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:LicenseRenewalTerm" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_MetrogasMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="ixv-120356">10</ix:nonNumeric> years pursuant to the Gas Law based on ENARGAS&#8217; recommendation to the PEN regarding the substantial performance of all its obligations, and the performance of Metrogas in the preceding term. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Upon the expiration of the <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:LicenseAgreementPeriod" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_MetrogasMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" id="ixv-77325">35 or <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">45-year</div> period</ix:nonNumeric>, as appropriate, the Gas Law requires a new competitive bidding for such License, in which, if Metrogas has performed its obligations, it will have the option to equal the best bid submitted to the PEN by a third party. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Generally, upon the termination of a Distribution License for term expiration, Metrogas will be entitled to a consideration equal to the value of the designated assets or to the amount paid by the successful bidder in a new call for tenders, whichever is lower. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_36" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_37"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; <td colspan="5" style="vertical-align:top"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</div></div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 1pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, 2023 AND 2022</div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_40" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_41"><ix:exclude> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL">(Amounts expressed in millions of United States dollars, except shares and per shares amounts expressed in United States dollars, and as otherwise indicated) </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>

<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_41" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_42"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In 2024, through the Bases Law, regulated by Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 (see Note 36.j)), the providers of public natural gas distribution and transportation services are allowed to request the renewal of their licenses for an additional <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:AdditionalLicenseRenewalTerm" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_MetrogasMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="ixv-120357">20</ix:nonNumeric>-year</div> period. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Metrogas has various obligations under the Gas Law, including the obligation to comply with all reasonable service requests within its service area, unless it were uneconomic for the provider, and to operate and maintain its facilities in a safe manner, which may require certain investments to replace or improve the facilities, as established in the Distribution License. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Also, the Distribution License specifies other obligations of Metrogas, including the provision of a distribution service, maintaining an uninterruptible service, operating the system in a prudent manner, maintaining the distribution network, making the mandatory investments, keeping certain accounting records and providing certain regular reports to the ENARGAS. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Distribution License may be revoked by the Argentine Government, upon recommendation of the ENARGAS, among other reasons, for serious and repeated failure by Metrogas to meet its obligations and/or total or partial interruptions (attributable to Metrogas) in the uninterruptible service outside the periods stipulated in the Distribution License; for the sale, disposal, transfer and encumbrance of Metrogas core assets (except for encumbrance used to finance extensions and improvements in the natural gas pipeline system) and in the event of bankruptcy, dissolution or liquidation of Metrogas. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Additionally, the Distribution License provides that Metrogas will not take over its parent company&#8217;s debts or grant credits or encumber assets to secure debts or award any other benefit to its parent company&#8217;s creditors. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Tariff schemes and tariff renegotiations</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">With the enactment of the Public Emergency Law of 2002, the legal framework in force applicable to license contracts of public utility companies was affected. This law provided for the conversion into pesos of tariffs established in convertible U.S. dollars at the exchange rate established under Convertibility Law No.&#160;23,928, the prohibition to adjust tariffs based on any foreign index, including the &#8220;U.S. PPI&#8221; established under the regulatory framework, and the process for renegotiating the public service contracts awarded by the PEN (including Metrogas&#8217; Distribution License). The expiration of the Public Emergency Law of 2002 was extended successively until December&#160;31, 2017, together with the terms for renegotiation of licenses and public service concessions. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Under the renegotiation process, on March&#160;30, 2017, Metrogas executed a Memorandum of Agreement with the MINEM and the Ministry of Finance for the Adjustment of the Natural Gas Distribution License (&#8220;Comprehensive Memorandum of Agreement&#8221;), which set out the conditions to adjust the Distribution License and a series of guidelines for the RTI, which included the introduction of <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-automatic</div> mechanisms for semi-annual adjustment of the distribution tariff between <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">5-year</div> tariff reviews (considering variations in prices and service costs). The Integral Tariff Minute, ratified by Decree No.&#160;252/2018, comprises the contractual period from January&#160;6, 2002 to the termination of the Distribution License. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Notwithstanding the variables contemplated for the RTI and tariff adjustment established thereunder, in 2019 the Argentine Government implemented several measures which significantly modified the economic and financial equation provided for in the RTI and in the mandatory investment plans submitted by distribution licensees, which caused a damage to Metrogas. Among the measures generating the most significant changes, thus causing lower revenues stand out, mainly for the deferral of the semi-annual tariff adjustment and higher costs related to the calculation of the UNG. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In consideration of the aforementioned, on October&#160;11, 2019 Metrogas filed an administrative claim with the ENARGAS, requesting the review and adjustment of its mandatory investment plan as well as an economic compensation to restore the economic and financial balance, together with the reconsideration of certain regulatory measures. This claim was later updated due to the continuous impact of the Solidarity Law and the new measures adopted in 2020, which are described below. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_42" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_43"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_43" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_44"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_44" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_45"><ix:exclude> <div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_45" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_46"><ix:exclude>

<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_47" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_48"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;23, 2019, Law No.&#160;27,541 (&#8220;Solidarity Law&#8221;) was published in the BO, declaring a state of public emergency in terms of economic, financial, fiscal, administrative, social security, tariff, energy, health and social matters, and suspending the adjustment of tariff schemes for power and natural gas distribution and transportation under federal jurisdiction, until the effective date of the new provisional tariff schemes (Decree No.&#160;1,020/2020). In addition, it delegated to the PEN the power to begin extraordinary reviews of current RTI and authorized the PEN to administratively intervene the ENARGAS for the term of 1 year, which was formalized by Decree No.&#160;278/2020. The <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">1-year</div> term was then extended by Decree No.&#160;1,020/2020 until December&#160;31, 2021 or until completion of the RTI. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;17, 2020, Decree No.&#160;1,020/2020 was published, ordering the commencement of the RTI for providers of power and natural gas public distribution and transportation services under federal jurisdiction, establishing a maximum negotiation term of 2 years, and providing for the elaboration of a RTT until completion of the RTI. On December&#160;7, 2022, Decree No.&#160;815/2022 was published in the BO, extending both the administrative intervention of the ENARGAS to January&#160;1, 2024 or until completion of the RTI, and the RTI negotiation term to December&#160;16, 2023. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On April&#160;28, 2023, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;190/2023 was published in the BO, approving the new transition tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas to consumption from April 2023. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;18, 2023, Decree No.&#160;55/2023 was published, ordering the commencement of the RTI (see Note 36.c.6)). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On April&#160;3, 2024, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;120/2024 was published in the BO, approving the transition tariff schemes and rates and charges for services to be applied by Metrogas as from such date, and the tariff update formula applicable on such transaction tariff schemes as from May 2024. Notwithstanding, the tariff updates for the months of May, June and July 2024 were deferred and therefore not carried out by instruction from the Ministry of Economy to ENARGAS, which generated a challenge by Metrogas to these instructions. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On June&#160;6, 2024, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;260/2024 was published in the BO, approving the transition tariff schemes and rates and charges for services to be applied by Metrogas as from such date. See Note 36.d.1). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;4, 2024, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;737/2024 was published in the BO, approving the transition tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas as from such date. See Note 36.d.1). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;3, 2024, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;828/2024 was published in the BO, approving the transition tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas as from such date. See Note 36.d.1). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On January&#160;30, 2025, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;60/2025 was published in the BO, approving the transition tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas as from February&#160;1, 2025. See Note 36.d.1). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">These transition measures will remain in force until the rates resulting from the RTI come into force, in accordance with the provisions of Decree No.&#160;55/2023. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Procedure for the compensation of the lower revenues received by distributors from their users for benefits and / or bonuses and for higher costs of unaccounted natural gas</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">MINEM Resolution No. <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">508-E/2017</div> established the procedure to compensate the lower revenues received by natural gas distribution licensees from users, as a result of the application of benefits to users under the regulations in force in terms of the social tariff and discounts for lower consumption, and the higher costs of UNG compared to those established for their recognition in tariffs, applicable from January&#160;1, 2018. However, on December&#160;7, 2018, the ENARGAS notified the SGE certain observations claiming that the SGE did not recognize the adjustment regarding UNG and determined that all amounts received from January 2018 to November 2018, which until such date were of a provisional nature, should be set off with the amounts owed by the SGE to Metrogas. Also, the adjustments of actual values established under such procedure for the same period, and the excess in costs incurred from December 2018 to September 2019 were not recognized either. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">This procedure complies with Article 20.2 of the Standard License approved by Decree No.&#160;2,255/1992, which provides that distributors have the right to compensation for the lower revenues caused by those measures in order to maintain the payment chain related to the operation and maintenance of the natural gas public distribution service through networks, including the payment of invoices for the purchase of natural gas and to ensure the continuity in the provision of the said public service. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_48" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_49"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_49" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_50"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_50" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_51"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_51" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_52"><ix:exclude>

<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_53" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_54"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Note from ENARGAS related to YPF&#8217;s equity interest in Metrogas</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;28, 2016, Metrogas received a Note from ENARGAS, requesting to adjust Metrogas&#8217; equity structure in compliance with deadline provided for in the Public Emergency Law of 2002 and in compliance with Article 34 of the Gas Law. In this regard, it should be noted that YPF indirectly acquired a 70% interest in Metrogas in a transaction that was approved by ENARGAS Resolution No. I/2,566 dated April&#160;19, 2013, and, following the merger with YPF Inversora Energ&#233;tica S.A. and Gas Argentino S.A. holds 70% of Metrogas shares. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;30, 2017, YPF filed an appeal for reconsideration requesting that the ENARGAS Note be revoked and a new decision be rendered setting a reasonable timeframe consistent with the current natural gas market situation, in order to comply with Article 34 of the Gas Law. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On June&#160;15, 2017, YPF submitted to the ENARGAS a tentative schedule for the process of adjusting its equity interest in Metrogas, which was extended in detail on July&#160;3, 2017. Such presentation does not imply the waiver of the aforementioned appeal. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On April&#160;5, 2018, ENARGAS rejected the reconsideration appeal filed by YPF on March&#160;30, 2017 by ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;313/2018. On October&#160;8, 2018, YPF filed an appeal for the SGE to decide on the issue. As of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements, the appeal is pending resolution. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.c.4) Regulatory framework associated with the LPG industry </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Law No.&#160;26,020, enacted in 2005 (&#8220;LPG Law&#8221;) lays down the regulatory framework for the LPG industry, covering all activities related to the production, fractionation, bottling, transportation, storage, distribution and sale of LPG, declaring them of public interest. It also establishes the free import of LPG, regardless of the restrictions or other measures established by the PEN where the product is subject to subsidies in the country of origin, and the free export of LPG once the supply of the domestic demand is ensured. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Under the LPG Law, which provides for the creation of a trust fund to finance bottled LPG consumption for low income consumers having no access to the distribution of natural gas through networks, the Argentine Government launched several programs stimulating the supply of the domestic market (see Note 36.d.2)). </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.c.5) Regulatory framework associated with electric power generation </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Group generates thermal conventional electrical energy and renewable energy through YPF EE and CT Barrag&#225;n. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The basic regulatory framework for Argentina&#8217;s electricity sector is laid down under Law No.&#160;15,336 of 1960, as amended by Law No.&#160;24,065 of 1991, and regulated by Decrees No.&#160;1,398/1992 and No.&#160;186/1995 (collectively the &#8220;Regulatory Framework&#8221;). This Regulatory Framework is supplemented by SE regulations regarding generation and commercialization of electric power, including former SEE Resolution No.&#160;61/1992. Also, in terms of generation of electric power from renewable sources, the Regulatory Framework is supplemented with specific regulations issued to promote their development (see Note 36.c.5) &#8220;Renewable energies&#8221; section). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Law No.&#160;24,065 implemented the privatization of state-owned companies in the electric power sector and divided the industry vertically into 4 categories: (i)&#160;generation; (ii) transmission; (iii)&#160;distribution; and (iv)&#160;demand. Also, the law organized the WEM (see Note 36.c.5) &#8220;WEM&#8221; section), where generators of electric power are one of its players. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Under Law No.&#160;24,065, the generation of electric power is defined as an activity of public interest developed in a competitive market. Generators of electric power from a thermal source (that is, generation by natural gas, petroleum liquids such as diesel and fuel oil, or coal), and from a renewable <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-hydraulic</div> source, do not require any concession from the state to operate. However, transmission and distribution activities are regulated as public services and hence are subject to concessions granted by the Argentine Government. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In turn, the provinces can regulate the electrical systems within their relevant territories, being their enforcement authority. However, if a participant of the provincial electrical sector connects to the Argentine Electricity Grid (&#8220;SADI&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish), it must also meet federal regulations. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_54" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_55"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_55" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_56"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_56" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_57"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_57" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_58"><ix:exclude>

<td style="vertical-align:top"><div style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">YPF SOCIEDAD ANONIMA</div></div></div></td>

<td colspan="5" style="vertical-align:top"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</div></div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 1pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, 2023 AND 2022</div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_58" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_59"><ix:exclude> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL">(Amounts expressed in millions of United States dollars, except shares and per shares amounts expressed in United States dollars, and as otherwise indicated) </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">

<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_59" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_60"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Argentina&#8217;s Electricity Regulator (&#8220;ENRE&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) is the agency regulating, auditing and controlling the electric power industry. The Bases Law created the &#8220;Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas y la Electricidad&#8221;, which will replace and assume the ENRE&#8217;s functions. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">CAMMESA</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">CAMMESA is responsible for SADI&#8217;s National Dispatch of Loads. CAMMESA&#8217;s main function is the technical and administrative coordination of electric power supply and demand within a real-time operation system, which includes determining the production schedule of all generation plants of the system in order to balance production with demand. CAMMESA also collects payments from all WEM agents and purchases and provides natural gas to generators, pursuant to the provisions of former SE Resolution No.&#160;95/2013, Article 8, as amended by Resolution No.&#160;12/2019 issued by the Ministry of Productive Development. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On January&#160;28, 2025, SE Resolution No.&#160;21/2025 was published in the BO, which, among other issues, provided that generators are authorized to make their fuel purchases, and their own fuels valued at the reference price and accepted in the Variable Cost of Production (&#8220;CVP&#8221; by its acronym in Spanish) statements will be recognized. Also, spot generators will be able to manage their own fuel and CAMMESA will continue to act as fuel supplier of last resort in the event that the spot generator opted not to do so. As of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements, the SE has not issued the regulatory, complementary and clarifying rules required for the implementation of this resolution. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">WEM</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The WEM is composed of a term market, with contracts for quantities, prices and conditions freely agreed between sellers and buyers, a spot market where prices are established on an hourly basis according to the economic cost of production, represented by the short-term marginal cost as measured at the system load center (market node), and a quarterly stabilization system for spot market prices, intended for distributor purchases. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Price of electricity dispatch and spot market</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In order to meet energy demand, CAMMESA prioritizes energy units with the lowest variable cost of production, progressively moving towards units with the highest variable costs of production, until the entire demand is covered. Thus, CAMMESA must define an optimum market price considering the typical hourly demand curves and the existing limitations of the system. This procedure must be used to project future SAID and WEM requirements. However, gaps between projections and prevailing market conditions generate differences between distributors&#8217; energy purchases at seasonal prices and payments to generators for sales of energy at spot prices. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Since the enactment of the Public Emergency Law of 2002 and the emergency of the electricity sector through Decree No.&#160;134/2015, a series of temporary provisions modified the original pricing system. Among the main regulations published, the resolutions related to the following stand out: management and dispatch of fuels, calls for tenders for the provision of additional thermal generation and associated electric power production capacity, subject to special remuneration mechanisms, formalizing commitments through contracts between generators and CAMMESA; calls for tenders to incorporate new efficient electric energy generation through the closing of open cycles and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">co-generation;</div> and resolutions by the SE implementing new remuneration mechanisms for the power energy generation sector. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On February&#160;26, 2020, SE Resolution No.&#160;31/2020 set the conversion to pesos of the remuneration of generation units not committed under contracts (set in U.S. dollars since former SEE Resolution No.&#160;19/2017). Subsequently, the SE, through new resolutions has been determining increases in the aforementioned remuneration regime. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As regards the remuneration regime of authorized thermal generators, it was provided that their remuneration would be composed of a payment for the monthly available power, a payment for generated power and another for operated power, plus another payment for energy generated in hours of maximum thermal requirement. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_60" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_61"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_61" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_62"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_62" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_63"><ix:exclude> <div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_63" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_64"><ix:exclude>

<td colspan="5" style="vertical-align:top"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</div></div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 1pt; font-size: 8pt; font-family: ARIAL; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, 2023 AND 2022</div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_64" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_65"><ix:exclude> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL">(Amounts expressed in millions of United States dollars, except shares and per shares amounts expressed in United States dollars, and as otherwise indicated) </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">

<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_65" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_66"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Renewable energies</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In recent years, Argentina issued regulations in order to regulate and incorporate renewable energies into the WEM and to promote their development through incentives in the form of tax benefits and preferential or subsidized tariffs. Thus, in 2006, Law No.&#160;26,190 was enacted, which established a National Promotion Regime for the Use of Renewable Energy Sources, subsequently amended in 2015 by Law No.&#160;27,191. These regulations, among other issues, set targets for the consumption of renewable energies for all electricity consumers, and specifically, for large users in terms of the minimum percentage of electricity from renewable energies they are required to consume, and establish tax benefits for eligible projects. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Among the main regulations aimed at encouraging the use of renewable energy, the following stand out: </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:2%">&#160;</td>
<td style="width:3%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left">-</td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;">Former MEyM Resolution No. <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">281-E/2017,</div> approving the Renewable Energy Term Market (&#8220;MATER&#8221;), which allows large users to meet their consumption quotas of electric power from renewable sources through: (i)&#160;the joint purchase system (through CAMMESA); (ii) the signing of private Power Supply Agreements (&#8220;CAE&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish); or (iii)&#160;the development of a self-generation or <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">co-generation</div> project. As a general principle, the CAEs signed on the MATER (outside the joint purchase system) may be freely negotiated between the parties. </div></td></tr></table> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:2%">&#160;</td>
<td style="width:3%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left">-</td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;">The RenovAr Program (Rounds 1, 1.5, 2 and 3) established under former MEyM Resolutions No.&#160;136/2016, No.&#160;252/2016, No.&#160;275/2017, and former SGE Resolution No.&#160;100/2018, which feature calls for bids for contracting electric power from renewable energies on the WEM, in compliance with their respective bidding terms and conditions. </div></td></tr></table> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.c.6) Decree No.&#160;55/2023 &#8220;Emergency in the national energy sector&#8221; </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;18, 2023, Decree No.&#160;55/2023 was published in the BO declaring the emergency in the national energy sector with respect to the generation, transportation and distribution of electric energy under federal jurisdiction, and transportation and distribution of natural gas. Such declaration and the actions arising from it will be effective until December&#160;31, 2024. Such decree established: (i)&#160;the commencement of the RTI of the providers of such public services, whose effective term shall not exceed December&#160;31, 2024; and (ii)&#160;the intervention of the ENARGAS and the ENRE from January&#160;1, 2024. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;18, 2023, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;704/2023 was published in the BO in order to put into consideration through public hearing: (i)&#160;the transitional adjustment of tariffs for the public service of natural gas transportation and natural gas distribution through networks; (ii)&#160;the transfer to tariffs of the price of purchased natural gas; (iii)&#160;the determination of the monthly price update for tariffs of the public service of natural gas transportation and natural gas distribution through networks; (iv)&#160;the treatment of the impact of the price of natural gas on UNG; and (v)&#160;the reversal of the Gasoducto Norte pipeline. On February&#160;15, 2024, ENARGAS Resolution No.&#160;52/2024 was published in the BO which declared the validity of the aforementioned public hearing and established that the approval of the transitory tariffs will take place within 30 days of the publication of this resolution. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;20, 2024, Decree No.&#160;1,023/2024 was published in the BO extending the emergency of the national energy sector until July&#160;9, 2025. Also, it provided: (i)&#160;the extension of the intervention of ENRE and ENARGAS until the constitution, commencement and appointment of the members of the Board of Directors of &#8220;Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas y la Electricidad&#8221;; and (ii)&#160;that the entry into force of the tariff schemes resulting from the RTI initiated pursuant to Decree No.&#160;55/2023 may not exceed form July&#160;9, 2025. </div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.d) Incentive programs for hydrocarbon production </div></div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.d.1) Incentive programs for natural gas production </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">With the purpose of increasing production and the offer of natural gas in the domestic market, considering the Argentina&#8217;s energy trade balance deficit, the Argentine Government implemented several programs to stimulate natural gas domestic production: </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Stimulus Program for Investments in Natural Gas Production Developments from Unconventional Reservoirs (&#8220;Resolution 46 Program&#8221;)</div> </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">By MINEM Resolution No. <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">46-E/2017</div> Resolution 46 Program was created with the purpose of encouraging investments in the production of natural gas from unconventional reservoirs in the Neuquina basin from March&#160;1, 2018 until December&#160;31, 2021. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Compensations under Resolution 46 Program would be paid as follows: <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfCompensationDistributedInProgramToCompanies" contextRef="P01_01_2021To12_31_2021_Resolution46ProgramMemberYPFPlanName1Axis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120358">88</ix:nonFraction>% to producing companies and <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfCompensationDistributedInProgramToProvince" contextRef="P01_01_2021To12_31_2021_Resolution46ProgramMemberYPFPlanName1Axis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120359">12</ix:nonFraction>% to the province where the concession included in the program is located. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div> </div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_66" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_67"><div></div></ix:continuation></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_67" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_68"><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; <td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_70" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_71"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Within this context, the Company filed administrative objections to several payment resolutions in relation to the concessions for which it obtained adhesion. As of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements, the SE has not issued any resolution on this respect. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Plan for the Promotion of Argentine Natural Gas Production - Supply and Demand Scheme 2020-2024 (&#8220;Plan GasAr 2020-2024&#8221;)</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;16, 2020, Decree No.&#160;892/2020 was published in the BO, which approved the Plan GasAr 2020-2024, mainly aimed at: encouraging investments in natural gas production to meet demand requirements with domestic production; generating long-term certainty in the production and distribution sectors; ensuring the supply of the priority demand and the thermoelectric generation segment; and establishing a transparent, open and competitive system for the formation of natural gas prices. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Plan GasAr 2020-2024, initially effective for a <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">4-year</div> term, will be implemented through the execution of individual contracts between natural gas producers, distributors and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">sub-distributors</div> (to satisfy the priority demand) and CAMMESA (to satisfy the thermoelectric generation demand). The Plan GasAr 2020-2024 provides that individual contracts shall be negotiated through an auction or bidding process for a total base volume of 70,000,000 m<div style="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div>/d for the 365 days of each calendar year of the plan term, ensuring demand aggregation mechanism allowing to meet natural gas requirements of the priority demand and power plants, plus exports in the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-winter</div> period. Also, it established that the Argentine Government may decide to undertake the monthly payment of the portion of natural gas prices at the PIST in order to mitigate the impact of the cost of natural gas to be transferred to <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">end-users.</div> Thus, the Argentine Government shall pay each producer a compensation equal to the difference between the price billed to distributors and/or <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">sub-distributors</div> and the seasonal price tendered, as appropriate. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Additionally, participating producers shall undertake to reach a production curve per basin that ensures the maintenance and/or increase of current production levels, according to bids presented. If the production curve is not achieved, reductions proportional to the tendered price may be applied, including the eventual removal of the producer from the Plan GasAr 2020-2024. Also, penalties may be imposed if the investment commitment undertaken or the commitment to increase Argentine value added is not complied with. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;24, 2020, SE Resolution No.&#160;317/2020 was published in the BO, calling a public tender for the effective award of the total base volume provided for under the Plan GasAr 2020-2024 and an additional volume for each of the winter periods from 2021 to 2024. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;16, 2020, SE Resolution No.&#160;391/2020 (supplemented by SE Resolution No.&#160;447/2020) was published in the BO, which awarded the base natural gas volumes and approved natural gas prices at the PIST corresponding to the awarded volumes. Under this resolution, the Company was awarded an annual natural gas supply of up to 7,628.5 Mm<div style="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div> (20.9 Mm<div style="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div>/d, the total volume tendered in the auction, all corresponding to the Neuquina basin, in line with a committed production curve of 30 Mm<div style="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div>/d). From the total committed volume, 56% will be used to cover the demand of power plants through CAMMESA and the remaining 44% will be used to supply distributors&#8217; priority demand. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;4, 2021, AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;4,939/2021 was published in the BO, establishing a procedure to register, apply for and assign tax credit certificates under the securities system established in Annex to Decree No.&#160;892/2020 with the purpose of supporting the payment of the compensation to be borne by the Argentine Government as defined in the such annex. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As of December&#160;31, 2024, the Company has received compensations from the National Government for an accumulated total amount of <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:CompensationsfromtheNationalGovernmentforthePlanGasAr20202024" contextRef="PAsOn12_31_2024" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120360">469</ix:nonFraction>. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_71" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_72"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; However, no export license holder may export in each seasonal period more than 30% of the total volume authorized to be exported or more than 50% of its delivery commitment under the Plan GasAr 2023-2028, whichever is lower, in compliance with the respective regulations. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;23, 2022, SE Resolution No.&#160;860/2022 was published in the BO, which established: (i)&#160;the approval of the national public tender called by Resolution SE No.&#160;770/2022; (ii) the extension of the delivery commitments undertaken by producers under the Plan GasAr 2020-2024 for the supply of distribution and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">sub-distribution</div> licensees, ENARSA and CAMMESA, from January&#160;1, 2025 to December&#160;31, 2028 for a volume of up to 20,900,000 m<div style="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div>/d; and (iii)&#160;the award of natural gas volumes to suppliers. vertical-align:top;display:inline;font-size:7.5px">3</div>/d (&#8220;Peak Gas 2024&#8221;) under the Plan GasAr 2023-2028. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On September&#160;27, 2023, SE Resolution No.&#160;799/2023 was published in the BO, awarding the Company monthly volumes of natural gas supply to the Northwest basin for the October 2023 - December 2028 period under the Plan GasAr 2023-2028. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;27, 2024, SE Resolution No.&#160;41/2024 was published in the BO, which approved natural gas prices at the PIST in U.S. dollars corresponding to the awarded volumes entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 which will be applicable for natural gas consumptions made: (i)&#160;from April&#160;1 and until April&#160;30, 2024; (ii) from May&#160;1 and until September&#160;30, 2024; and (iii)&#160;from October&#160;1 and until December&#160;31, 2024; and instructed that, for the purpose of transferring the prices of natural gas to the tariff schemes of the public service of distribution of natural gas, ENARGAS issue the tariff schemes that reflect on a monthly basis the variation of the exchange rate of the prices of natural gas to be transferred to the tariff schemes. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On 5&#160;June 2024, SE Resolution No.&#160;93/2024 was published in the BO, which approved natural gas prices at the PIST in U.S. dollars corresponding to the awarded volumes entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 which will be applicable for natural gas consumptions from June 2024 and leaves without effect the instruction to ENARGAS to issue tariff schemes that reflect on a monthly basis the variation of the exchange rate of the prices of natural gas to be transferred to the tariff schemes. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; See Note 36.c.2). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;3, 2024, SE Resolution No.&#160;386/2024 was published in the BO, approving the natural gas prices at the PIST corresponding to the awarded volumes entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 which will be applicable for natural gas consumptions from December 2024. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_77" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_78"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_78" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_79"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_79" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_80"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_80" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_81"><ix:exclude>
