font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On January&#160;31, 2025, SE Resolution No.&#160;25/2025 was published in the BO, approving the natural gas prices at the PIST corresponding to the awarded volumes entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 which will be applicable for natural gas consumptions from February 2025. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;5, 2025, SE Resolution No.111/2025 was published in the BO, approving the natural gas prices at the PIST corresponding to the awarded volumes entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 which will be applicable for natural gas consumptions from March 2025. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.d.2) Incentive programs for the domestic supply of LPG </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">With the purpose of ensuring the supply of LPG to the domestic market at affordable prices ensuring LPG availability to <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">low-income</div> users who have no access to the supply of natural gas through networks, the Argentine Government has implemented the following programs of relevance to the Company: </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="white-space:nowrap;display:inline;">Bottle-to</div> Bottle Program</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Concerning the bottled LPG segment, the LPG Law (see Note 36.c.4)) established the creation of a trust fund to finance the consumption of LPG in 10, 12, y <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">15-kg</div> bottles for <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">low-income</div> users having no access to natural gas distribution through networks, thereby granting the SE the power to establish reference prices. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In 2015, in the context mentioned above, the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Bottle-to</div> Bottle Program was created by Decree No.&#160;470/2015, subsequenty regulated through SE Resolution No.&#160;49/2015. The purpose of this program is to maintain price stability in the commercialization chain of butane and propane to be used in 10, 12 and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">15-kg</div> bottles and in certain supply areas. As provided for under <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Bottle-to</div> Bottle Program regulations, at present the SE establishes, on an annual basis, the quotas of butane for the supply of the domestic market by producers, and the reference prices applicable on each ocassion to bottled LPG for residential use. Under the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Bottle-to</div> Bottle Program, producers would be paid a compensation, which was finally set at 0 from February&#160;1, 2019 by SGE Resolution No.&#160;15/2019. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On August&#160;19, 2024, SE Resolution No.&#160;216/2024 was published in the BO, which resolved to eliminate the maximum prices applicable set for bottled LPG for residential use and replace them with an uncapped reference price system. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On January&#160;24, 2025, SE Resolution No.&#160;15/2025 was published in the BO, which established that producers&#8217; sales prices to fractionators must not exceed the export parity price. Likewise, producers must ensure that LPG is continuously and sufficiently available for the domestic market. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Propane Network Agreement</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In order to guarantee the stability of the conditions for the supply of undiluted propane through networks, on December&#160;27, 2002, the Ministry of Economy entered into an agreement with LPG producers for the supply of propane gas for distribution networks of undiluted propane gas effective until April&#160;30, 2003 and renewable for a maximum term of 1 year. Later, under Law No.&#160;26,019 of 2005, Law No.&#160;26,546 of 2009 and Decree No.&#160;496/2023, the agreement was authorized to be extended until December&#160;31, 2023. A new Propane Network Agreement was signed and its term was extended to December&#160;31, 2024. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The agreement guarantees the supply of a given volume of propane gas to distributors and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">sub-distributors</div> of propane gas through networks at a given price and the payment of an economic compensation to LPG producers for their lower revenues. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.d.3) Investment Promotion Regime for the Exploitation of Hydrocarbons - Decree No.&#160;929/2013 </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Decree No.&#160;929/2013 provides for the creation of an Investment Promotion Regime for the Exploitation of Hydrocarbons (&#8220;Promotional Regime&#8221;), both for conventional and unconventional hydrocarbon exploitation projects. Inclusion in this Regime may be applied for by holders of hydrocarbon exploration permits and/or exploitation concessions and/or any third parties associated to such holders jointly with them, which have filed an investment project in foreign currency of at least <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:DirectInvestmentInForeignCurrency" contextRef="PAsOn12_31_2024_InvestmentPromotionRegimeForTheExploitationOfHydrocarbonsDecreeNo9292013MemberYPFDecreeTypeAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120361">1,000</ix:nonFraction>, computed as of the date the project was filed, to be invested during the first 5 years of the project (this amount was modified in 2014 by Law No.&#160;27,007 and reduced to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:DirectInvestmentInForeignCurrencyAfterAmendment" contextRef="PAsOn12_31_2024_InvestmentPromotionRegimeForTheExploitationOfHydrocarbonsDecreeNo9292013MemberYPFDecreeTypeAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120362">250</ix:nonFraction>). </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_83" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_84"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_84" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_85"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_85" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_86"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; <td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_88" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_89"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The following are the main benefits established for entities reached by this regime: (i)&#160;they will be entitled, under the terms of Law No.&#160;17,319, and from the fifth successive year counted since the commencement of their respective projects, to freely sell to foreign markets <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfSaleOnProductionOfLiquidAndGaseousHydrocarbons" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_InvestmentPromotionRegimeForTheExploitationOfHydrocarbonsDecreeNo9292013MemberYPFDecreeTypeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120363">20</ix:nonFraction>% of their production of liquid and gaseous hydrocarbons produced under the said projects, with a <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportDutyForLiquidAndGaseousHydrocarbonsPercent" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_InvestmentPromotionRegimeForTheExploitationOfHydrocarbonsDecreeNo9292013MemberYPFDecreeTypeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120364">0</ix:nonFraction>% export duty, should these be applicable; (ii)&#160;they will be entitled to free availability of 100% of any foreign currency obtained from the export of the hydrocarbons mentioned in the preceding item; and (iii)&#160;for periods where national production fails to meet domestic supply needs under the terms of Article 6 of Law No.&#160;17,319, entities included in the regime will be entitled to obtain, from fifth year following the approval and commencement of their respective projects with respect to the percentage of liquid and gaseous hydrocarbons produced under such projects available for export as mentioned herein above, a price not lower that the reference export price, which will be determined without computing the incidence of export duties otherwise applicable. See Note 36.h), &#8220;Investment Promotion Regime for the Exploitation of Hydrocarbons - Decree No.&#160;929/2013&#8221; section. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.e) Investment incentive programs </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Large Investment Incentive Regime (&#8220;RIGI&#8221;)</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Bases Law (see Note 36.j)) created the RIGI, regulated by Decree No.&#160;749/2024 published in the BO on August&#160;23, 2024, General Resolution No.&#160;1,074/2024 of the Ministry of Economy published in the BO on October&#160;22, 2024 and AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,590/2024 published in the BO on October&#160;23, 2024, which is intended to encourage large investments with tax, customs and exchange benefits, guaranteeing legal certainty and the protection of acquired rights. This regime seeks to encourage investments, promote economic development, create employment and strengthen local production chains. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The RIGI is aimed at investment projects in the forestry industry, tourism, infrastructure, mining, technology, iron and steel, energy and oil and gas sectors, with a minimum investment per sector or subsector or productive stage equal to or greater than a range between US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:DirectInvestmentInForeignCurrency" contextRef="PAsOn12_31_2024_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis_HydrocarbonDistributionMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120365">200,000,000</ix:nonFraction> up to US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:DirectInvestmentInForeignCurrency" contextRef="PAsOn12_31_2024_HydrocarbonDistributionMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120366">900,000,000</ix:nonFraction> in computable assets, as established by the enforcement authority. Interested parties have 2 years to adhere to the RIGI, submitting and obtaining the approval of an investment plan by the enforcement authority. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The benefits of the RIGI include a 25% income tax rate, accelerated amortization of investments, <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-expirable</div> tax loss carryforwards, indexing tax losses by the Internal Wholesale Price Index (&#8220;IPIM&#8221;) published by the INDEC, and exemptions from import and export duties, among others. In addition, foreign exchange incentives are established, such as the free availability of foreign currency on a staggered basis obtained from exports and certain flexibility related to financing. The RIGI guarantees tax, customs and foreign exchange regulatory stability for 30 years from accession, protecting investment projects from more burdensome legislative changes. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f) Tax regulations </div></div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.1) Income tax </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Law No.&#160;27,468, published in the BO on December&#160;4, 2018, established that the inflation adjustment procedure for taxation purposes will be applicable for fiscal years beginning January&#160;1, 2018. In the first, second and third fiscal years since it became effective, this procedure shall be applicable if the variation in the CPI, estimated from the beginning to the end of each of those years exceeds <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageRateVariationInTheCPI" contextRef="P01_01_2018To12_31_2018" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120367">55</ix:nonFraction>%, <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageRateVariationInTheCPI" contextRef="P01_01_2019To12_31_2019" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120368">30</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageRateVariationInTheCPI" contextRef="P01_01_2020To12_31_2020" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120369">15</ix:nonFraction>%, for the first, second and third year of application, respectively. From the fourth year, i.e., fiscal year beginning on January&#160;1, 2021, the procedure will apply to the extent the CPI variation accumulated over 36 months prior to the applicable fiscal year end exceeds 100%. Considering that the CPI as of December&#160;31, 2024, 2023 and 2022 exceeds the mentioned parameters, the Group applied the tax adjustment for inflation in its income tax estimate. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_89" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_90"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_90" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_91"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_91" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_92"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_92" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_93"><ix:exclude>

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_94" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_95"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On June&#160;16, 2021 Law No.&#160;27,630 was published in the BO, introducing the following amendments to the Income Tax Law: </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:start; BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt;border:0;width:100%">

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;">The income tax rate for companies and permanent establishments, applicable to fiscal years beginning on or after January&#160;1, 2021, was modified. To such end, it introduced a scale of rates ranging from <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" contextRef="P01_01_2021To12_31_2021_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120370">25</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" contextRef="P01_01_2021To12_31_2021_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120371">35</ix:nonFraction>% to be applied according to the taxpayer&#8217;s accumulated taxable net profit, and such amounts will be adjusted annually according to the CPI. </div></td></tr></table>

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;">The distribution of dividends and profits to individuals, undivided estates and foreign beneficiaries is subject to a <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:TaxRateOfDistributionOfDividendsAndProfitsToIndividualsUndividedEstatesAndForeignBeneficiaries" contextRef="P01_01_2021To12_31_2021" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120372">7</ix:nonFraction>% rate. </div></td></tr></table> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Income tax <div style="white-space:nowrap;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> for taxpayers with extraordinary income </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On August&#160;16, 2022, AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,248/2022 was published in the BO, which established a <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">one-time</div> extraordinary <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> on account of income tax applicable to companies meeting one of the following conditions in fiscal year 2021 or 2022: (i) the amount of income tax determined is equal to or higher than <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncomeTaxDeterminedForFiscalYear2021Or2022" contextRef="P08_16_2022To08_16_2022" unitRef="Unit_ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120373">100</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million pesos; and/or (ii)&#160;the taxable income, before any tax loss carryforwards, is equal to or higher than <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:TaxableIncomeBeforeAnyTaxLossCarryforwardsForFiscalYear2021Or2022" contextRef="P08_16_2022To08_16_2022" unitRef="Unit_ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120374">300</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million pesos. This <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> is determined as follows: (i)&#160;for taxpayers whose <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payments</div> calculated under the general mechanism are higher than <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:TaxPrepaymentsCalculatedUnderTheGeneralMechanism" contextRef="P08_16_2022To08_16_2022" unitRef="Unit_ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120375">0</ix:nonFraction> pesos, <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfBasePrepaymentOfTaxArrivedOnGeneralMethod" contextRef="P08_16_2022To08_16_2022" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120376">25</ix:nonFraction>% of the base <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> already being applied; and (ii)&#160;for remaining taxpayers, <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfPrepaymentsOfTaxArrivedWithoutConsideringTheTaxLosses" contextRef="P08_16_2022To08_16_2022" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120377">15</ix:nonFraction>% of taxable income without considering the tax loss carryforwards. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On July&#160;21, 2023, AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,391/2023 was published in the BO, establishing a <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">one-time</div> extraordinary <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> on account of the income tax for taxpayers which, in their tax returns for fiscal year 2022 or 2023, as appropriate, meet the following conditions: (i)&#160;have reported a taxable income, without applying tax loss carryforwards, of at least <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:TaxableIncomeMinimumExcludingTaxLossesCarryForwards" contextRef="P07_21_2023To07_21_2023_TwoThousandAndTwentyTwoAndTwoThousandAndTwentyThreeMemberYPFPeriodAxis" unitRef="Unit_ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120378">600</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million pesos; and (ii)&#160;have not determined any income tax. This extraordinary <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> is estimated by applying <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfPrepaymentsOfTaxArrivedWithoutConsideringTheTaxLosses" contextRef="P07_21_2023To07_21_2023_TwoThousandAndTwentyTwoAndTwoThousandAndTwentyThreeMemberYPFPeriodAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120379">15</ix:nonFraction>% on the taxable income of the fiscal year immediately preceding that in which the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-payment</div> is to be recorded, without considering tax loss carryforwards. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Budget Law 2023 - Deferral of tax adjustment for inflation </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;1, 2022, Law No.&#160;27,701 was published in the BO, which introduced changes to the Income Tax Law, establishing the possibility of deferring the tax adjustment for inflation contemplated under such law corresponding to the first and second fiscal years beginning in January 2022, allowing to record, at taxpayer&#8217;s choice, one third of the adjustment in such fiscal year and the remaining two thirds in equal parts in the immediately following two periods. This benefit will only be admissible for subjects whose investment in the purchase, construction, manufacturing or final import of fixed assets, except automobiles, in each of the 2 fiscal periods immediately following the calculation of the respective first third, is equal or higher than <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:MinimumInvestmentForDeferralOfTaxAdjustmentForInflation" contextRef="P12_01_2022To12_01_2022_ChangesInTaxRatesOrTaxLawsEnactedOrAnnouncedMemberifrsfullNonadjustingEventsAfterReportingPeriodAxis" unitRef="Unit_ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120380">30,000</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million pesos. </div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.2) Personal assets tax - Substitute taxpayer </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Individuals and foreign entities, and undivided estates, regardless of whether they are domiciled or located in Argentina or abroad, are subject to a personal assets tax of <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PersonalAssetsTaxRate" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120381"><ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PersonalAssetsTaxRate" contextRef="P01_01_2023To12_31_2023" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120382"><ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PersonalAssetsTaxRate" contextRef="P01_01_2022To12_31_2022" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120383">0.50</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% of the value of any shares or ADS issued by Argentine entities. The tax is levied on the Argentine issuers of such shares or ADS, such as YPF, which must pay this tax as substitutes for the respective shareholders and is based on the equity value (following the equity method), or the carrying amount of the shares derived from the last financial statements as of December&#160;31 of each year. Under the Personal Assets Tax Law, the Group is entitled to seek reimbursement of the tax paid by the shareholders subject to such tax, using the reimbursement method the Group considers appropriate. </div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.3) Fuels tax </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">From the existence of market prices for petroleum products following the deregulation of the hydrocarbon sector, Law No.&#160;23,966 established a tax on liquid fuel transfers, which levied certain types of fuels, replacing the former regime based on regulated prices. Since August 2003, the calculation method originally consisting of a fixed value per liter according to the respective type of fuel was replaced by a rate on the average sales price. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Later, under the Tax Reform, the new mechanism was modified reestablishing the fixed amounts per liter, which are adjusted quarterly based on variations in the CPI. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_95" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_96"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_96" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_97"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_97" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_98"><ix:exclude> <div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_98" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_99"><ix:exclude>

<td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_100" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_101"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Incentive Regime for the Internal Supply of Fuels (&#8220;RIAIC&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On June&#160;16, 2022, Decree No.&#160;329/2022 was published in the BO, creating a promotion regime that allows refining and/or integrated refining companies to receive an amount equal to the sum they have to pay as tax on Liquid Fuels and Carbon Dioxide (&#8220;Tax on fuels&#8221;) for diesel imports, which may be applied to pay such tax. The RIAIC was applicable to diesel imports and crude oil transfers from June&#160;16 to August&#160;16, 2022, that meet certain requirements established in said decree and its corresponding regulation. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On February&#160;22, 2023, Decree No.&#160;86/2023 was published in the BO through which the RIAIC is reestablished, recognizing an amount equivalent to what refining companies and/or integrated refiners must pay as fuel tax for diesel and gasoline imports made between January&#160;1 and February&#160;28, 2023, which could be applied to the amount to be paid for such tax up to a limit of <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" contextRef="P02_22_2023To02_22_2023_ChangesInTaxRatesOrTaxLawsEnactedOrAnnouncedMemberifrsfullNonadjustingEventsAfterReportingPeriodAxis_ImportedDieselMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120384">20</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" contextRef="P02_22_2023To02_22_2023_ChangesInTaxRatesOrTaxLawsEnactedOrAnnouncedMemberifrsfullNonadjustingEventsAfterReportingPeriodAxis_ImportedGasolineMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120385">17</ix:nonFraction>% of the sales in the domestic market of imported diesel and gasoline, respectively, that meet certain requirements established in said decree and its corresponding regulation. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On July&#160;10, 2023, SE Resolution No.&#160;570/2023 was published in the BO, extending the effective term of the RIAIC established through Decree No.&#160;86/2023 for all import operations of diesel and gasoline carried out from March&#160;1, 2023, to April&#160;30, 2023, that meet certain requirements established in said decree and its corresponding regulation. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On September&#160;7, 2023, Decree No.&#160;461/2023 was published in the BO, which reestablished the RIAIC for all import operations of diesel and gasoline carried out from August&#160;1, 2023, to October&#160;31, 2023, that meet certain requirements. On November&#160;23, 2023, SE Resolution No.&#160;952/2023 was published in the BO, which extended the effective term of the provisions of Decree No.&#160;461/2023 for all import operations of diesel and/or gasoline carried out until November&#160;30, 2023. </div> <div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.4) Regime for the regularization of taxes </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On August&#160;26, 2020, Law No.&#160;27,562 &#8220;Law on Social Solidarity and Production Reactivation within the Public Emergency Framework&#8221; was published in the BO, which declared the extension of the regularization of tax, social security and customs obligations originally established for micro, small and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">medium-sized</div> enterprises (&#8220;MSMEs&#8221;) under Law No.&#160;27,541. In the case of legal entities owning financial assets abroad, they should previously comply with the requirement to repatriate at least <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageRepatriationOfAssetsLegalCompliance" contextRef="P08_26_2020To08_26_2020" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120386">30</ix:nonFraction>% of those assets within 60 days from the date they adhered to the regime (including shareholders holding at least <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageRepatriationOfAssetsLegalCompliance" contextRef="P08_26_2020To08_26_2020" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120387">30</ix:nonFraction>% of the capital stock). </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The regime allowed to include obligations past due as of July&#160;31, 2020 and established a cash discount or plans from <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:PaymentInPlansInstalmentsDescription" contextRef="P07_31_2020To07_31_2020" id="ixv-120388">48 to 120 installments</ix:nonNumeric>, depending on the type of debt and taxpayer, subject to a <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:BorrowingsInterestRate" contextRef="PAsOn07_31_2020_FixedInterestRateMemberifrsfullTypesOfInterestRatesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120389">2</ix:nonFraction>% fixed monthly interest rate in the first 6 installments and BADLAR rate in pesos at private banks from the seventh installment. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Adherence to the plan, which originally expired on October&#160;31, 2020, was successively extended until December&#160;15, 2020 by Decree No.&#160;966/2020. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;11, 2021, Law No.&#160;27,653 &#8220;Tax Relief Law to Strengthen the Recovery of Economic and Social Activities Affected by the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">COVID-19</div> Pandemic&#8221; was published in the BO, which (i)&#160;extended the moratorium granted under Law No.&#160;27,541 as amended by Law No.&#160;27,562 extending its deadlines and further covering obligations past due as of August&#160;31, 2021; (ii) with exclusive effect for the regularization of outstanding amounts detected by AFIP&#8217;s audit activity interest in excess of <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageInterestInExcessOfPrincipalOutstandingAmount" contextRef="P11_11_2021To11_11_2021" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120390">40</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal outstanding amount were written off and payment in plans of up to <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:PaymentInPlansInstalmentsDescription" contextRef="P11_11_2021To11_11_2021" id="ixv-120391">72 installments</ix:nonNumeric> was authorized, and (iii)&#160;removed the restrictions on dividend distribution prior to August&#160;26, 2022, unless the Company shall have <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-cancelled</div> such tax debt established under Law No.&#160;27,541. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In addition, AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,157/2022, published in the BO on February&#160;25, 2022, established that term for adherence to the regularization regime mentioned above was until March&#160;31, 2022, which was extended to April&#160;29, 2022, by AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,181/2022 published in the BO on April&#160;1, 2022. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div> <ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_101" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_102"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; <td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_106" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_107"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.5) Tax for an Inclusive and Solidary Argentina (&#8220;PAIS Tax&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On July&#160;24, 2023, Decree No.&#160;377/2023 was published in the BO, through which the scope of the PAIS Tax established by Law No.&#160;27,541 of 2019 to import operations of certain goods and services when access to the Exchange Market is required for their acquisition and payment. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The rates applied to foreign currency purchases are: (i) <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfTaxRateOnServicesAcquiredAbroad" contextRef="P07_24_2023To07_24_2023_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120392">25</ix:nonFraction>% for the acquisition of certain services abroad or provided in the country by <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-residents;</div> (ii) <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfTaxRateOnContractingServicesAndFreightServices" contextRef="P07_24_2023To07_24_2023_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120393">7.5</ix:nonFraction>% for contracting, abroad or in the country by <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-residents,</div> freight services and other transport services for the import or export of goods; and (iii) <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageTaxRateForImportOfGoods" contextRef="P07_24_2023To07_24_2023_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120394">7.5</ix:nonFraction>% for the import of goods, except for those mentioned in section 2 paragraph e) of Decree No.&#160;377/2023 and its corresponding regulations. On December&#160;13, 2023, Decree&#160;No. 29/2023 was published in the BO, which increased the rates mentioned in items (ii)&#160;and (iii) to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfTaxRateOnContractingServicesAndFreightServices" contextRef="P12_13_2023To12_13_2023_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120395"><ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageTaxRateForImportOfGoods" contextRef="P12_13_2023To12_13_2023_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120396">17.5</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>%. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On September&#160;2, 2024, Decree No.&#160;777/2024 was published in the BO, which reduced to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageTaxRateForImportOfGoods" contextRef="P09_02_2024To09_02_2024_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120397"><ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfTaxRateOnContractingServicesAndFreightServices" contextRef="P09_02_2024To09_02_2024_TaxRateForAnInclusiveAndSolidaryArgentinaMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120398">7.5</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% the rate applied to foreign currency purchases for contracting, abroad or in the country by <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">non-residents,</div> freight services and other transport services for the import or export of goods and for the import of goods, except for those mentioned in section 2 paragraph e) of Decree No.&#160;377/2023 and its corresponding regulations. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;24, 2024, the PAIS Tax ceased to be in effect. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.f.6) Tax benefits for price agreements </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On August&#160;26, 2023, Decree No.&#160;433/2023 was published in the BO, which established tax benefits effective until October&#160;31, 2023, for entities entering into price agreements for the domestic market with the Secretariat of Commerce of the Ministry of Economy or adjusting those agreements already in effect. These tax benefits include the suspension of the payment of the PAIS Tax for certain goods, the reduction to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfExportDutyAfterReduction" contextRef="P08_26_2023To08_26_2023_TaxBenefitsForPriceAgreementsMemberYPFSchemeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120399">0</ix:nonFraction>% of the rate of export duties for certain tariff headings, facility plans for the payment of export duties by certain productive sectors and the extension of the payment term of certain taxes and social security obligations. On October&#160;26, 2023, by Decree No.&#160;551/2023, these tax benefits were extended until December&#160;31, 2023. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.g) Customs regulations </div></div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.g.1) Export duties </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Export duties, taxes and other charges related to transactions carried out under the &#8220;Export Increase Program&#8221; and related to Decree No.&#160;492/2023, Decree No.&#160;549/2023, Decree No.&#160;597/2023 and Decree No.&#160;28/2023 shall be paid using as tax base the amount resulting from the foreign currencies received and settled in accordance with such decrees and their supplementary regulations (see Note 36.h)). </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Hydrocarbons </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Since September 2018, hydrocarbon export duties which had previously been effective since 2000 and were suspended in January 2017, were reestablished. Mechanisms varied from setting a fixed amount to establishing rates on the taxable value or FOB value. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On May&#160;19, 2020, Decree No.&#160;488/2020 was published in the BO, establishing a floating rate for hydrocarbon export duties ranging from <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:FloatingRateForHydrocarbonExportDuties" contextRef="PAsOn05_19_2020_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120400">0</ix:nonFraction>% (where the Brent crude oil price is equal to or below <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:BrentCrudePrice" contextRef="PAsOn05_19_2020_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_bbl" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120401">45</ix:nonFraction> US$/bbl) to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:FloatingRateForHydrocarbonExportDuties" contextRef="PAsOn05_19_2020_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120402">8</ix:nonFraction>% (where the Brent crude oil price is equal to or above <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:BrentCrudePrice" contextRef="PAsOn05_19_2020_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_bbl" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120403">60</ix:nonFraction> US$/bbl), which was effective until December 2021. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;31, 2020, Decree No.&#160;1,060/2020 was published in the BO, establishing a <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportDutyPercentage" contextRef="P01_01_2020To12_31_2020_ExportDutyRateMemberifrsfullTypesOfRateregulatedActivitiesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120404">4.5</ix:nonFraction>% export duty rate on goods included in Chapter 29 of the Mercosur Common Nomenclature (&#8220;NCM&#8221;), in which ethanol and methanol, among others, are included. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_107" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_108"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; <td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_112" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_113"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Agricultural products </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;4, 2020, Decree No.&#160;230/2020 was published in the BO, which established a <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P03_04_2020To03_04_2020_AgriculturalProductsMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120405">33</ix:nonFraction>% tax (maximum tax rate allowed under Law No.&#160;27,541) on the export of soybean and soybean byproducts. Tax rate on export of wheat, corn and sorghum remained at <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportDutyPercentage" contextRef="P03_04_2020To03_04_2020_WheatCornAndSorghumMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120406">12</ix:nonFraction>%. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On October&#160;5, 2020, Decree No.&#160;790/2020 was published in the BO, by which the export duties on soybean and soybean byproducts, such as soybean oil and soybean meal, are fixed at <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P10_05_2020To10_05_2020_SoybeanMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120407">33</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P10_05_2020To10_05_2020_SoybeanByproductsMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120408">31</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively, from January 2021. From March 2022, all export duties for the products mentioned above were set in <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P10_05_2020To10_05_2020_SoybeanMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120409">33</ix:nonFraction>%. As of January 2023, the export duties established by Decree No.&#160;790/2020 were restored. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On January&#160;27, 2025, Decree N&#176; 38/2025 was published in the BO, which established a temporary reduction in export duties for products such as soybean, soybean byproducts, grains, among others. The new rates were fixed at <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P01_27_2025To01_27_2025_SoybeanMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120410">26</ix:nonFraction>% for soybean, <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P01_27_2025To01_27_2025_SoybeanByproductsMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120411">24.5</ix:nonFraction>% for soybean byproducts such as soybean oil and soybean meal, and <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:ExportTaxRate" contextRef="P01_27_2025To01_27_2025_GrainsMemberifrsfullProductsAndServicesAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120412">9.5</ix:nonFraction>% for grains such as wheat, corn and sorghum, which will be in effect until June&#160;30, 2025. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.g.2) Customs collections </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On March&#160;29, 2023 AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,339/2023 was published in the BO, suspending, until December&#160;31, 2023, the application of exclusion certificates from the income tax and VAT collection regimes for final imports of goods. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In addition, in order to calculate income tax prepayments, collections as a result of the said suspension may no longer be computed, and in certain cases, computing VAT collections is temporarily restricted. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On August&#160;26, 2023, AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,407/2023 was published in the BO, which until October&#160;31, 2023: (i) suspends the application of the provisions of AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,339/2023 for the import of certain tariff headings; and (ii)&#160;excludes the application of the customs collection regimes of income tax and VAT on the import of certain tariff headings. In both cases, these tariff headings are determined by the SE and provided the imports are made by taxpayers indicated by the SE to such end. On November&#160;1, 2023, by AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,441/2023, the effective term of these provisions was extended until November&#160;30, 2023. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;29, 2023, by AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,476/2023, the provisions of AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,339/2023 were extended until June&#160;30, 2024, eliminating the temporary restrictions for computing VAT collections. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Subsequently, through AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,520/2024 of July&#160;1, 2024 and ARCA General Resolution No.&#160;5,624/2024 of December&#160;30, 2024, the provisions established by AFIP General Resolution No.&#160;5,339/2023 and its amendments were extended until June&#160;30, 2025. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On February&#160;28, 2025, by ARCA General Resolution No.&#160;5,655/2025, all the provisions described above were repealed. Such resolution is applicable to final imports completed as from March&#160;1, 2025. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_113" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_114"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_114" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_115"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_115" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_116"><ix:exclude><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_116" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_117"><ix:exclude>

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;">Access to the Foreign Exchange Market without prior BCRA approval to: (i)&#160;pay interest accrued as of January&#160;1, 2025; (ii) apply export proceeds to make principal and interest payments under cross-border financial indebtedness that were settled through the Foreign Exchange Market as of April&#160;19, 2024, provided the following conditions are met: (a)&#160;the average life of the indebtedness is not less than 3 years; and (b)&#160;the first principal payment thereunder is not made before one year has elapsed as from the transfer and settlement of the loan proceeds through the Foreign Exchange Market; and (iii)&#160;prepayment of principal and interest under cross-border financial indebtedness more than 3 business days prior to the scheduled maturity, provided the following conditions are met: (a)&#160;the access occurs simultaneously with the settlement of a new financial loan granted by a local financial entity based on cross-border credit line disbursed and settled through the Foreign Exchange Market as of April&#160;19, 2024; (b) the average life of the new debt is greater than the average remaining life of the debt being prepaid; and (c)&#160;the aggregate principal amount due under the new indebtedness does not exceed the aggregate principal amount due under the debt being prepaid. </div></td></tr></table><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Likewise, the BCRA enabled access to the Foreign Exchange Market to make principal or interest payments, in Argentina or abroad, under foreign currency-denominated debt securities issued by resident issuers, to the extent the securities were fully subscribed abroad, all issuance proceeds were settled through the Foreign Exchange Market. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As regards payment of imports of goods with customs entry registration prior to December&#160;13, 2023 and of services provided and/or rendered prior to such date (&#8220;debt stock&#8221;), resident importers are unable to access the Foreign Exchange Market but were allowed to subscribe Bonds for the Reconstruction of a Free Argentina (&#8220;BOPREAL&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) for an amount equal to amounts owed under such imports. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Those who had subscribed BOPREAL up to January&#160;31, 2024, for an amount equal to or greater than <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:MinimumPercentageOfDebtSubscribedForAccessToTheForeignMarket" contextRef="PAsOn01_31_2024_BeforeThirtyFirstOfJanuaryTwoThousandAndTwentyFourMemberYPFPeriodOfApplicabilityAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120414">25</ix:nonFraction>% of their debt stock, may access the Foreign Exchange Market as from February&#160;1, 2024, for the amounts and in compliance with the conditions established in the Foreign Exchange Regulations. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As regards the payment of imports of goods with customs entry registration as of December&#160;13, 2023 and of services provided and/or rendered as of such date, resident importers may access the Foreign Exchange Market without need for prior BCRA approval if, in addition to the requirements applicable in each case, the payment complies with the schedule established in the Foreign Exchange Regulations. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Foreign Currency Access Regime for Incremental Oil Production (&#8220;RADPIP&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) and Foreign Currency Access Regime for Incremental Natural Gas Production (&#8220;RADPIGN&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On May&#160;26, 2022, the Argentine Government issued Decree No.&#160;277/2022, creating the RADPIP and RADPIGN regimes, which provide certain benefits to companies that comply with, among others, the following requirements: (i)&#160;be registered with the Register of Oil Companies and be holders of hydrocarbon exploitation concessions; (ii)&#160;adhere to these regimes under the terms established by the SE; (iii)&#160;obtain an incremental production under the terms defined in the decree; and (iv)&#160;comply with the Regime for Promotion of Employment, Work and Development of Regional and National Providers of the Hydrocarbon Industry. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Beneficiaries of the RADPIP and RADPIGN regimes will have, for the percentage of incremental production according to item (iii)&#160;above, access to the Foreign Exchange Market without prior approval of the BCRA for the payment of principal of commercial and financial debts, profits and dividends, among others. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Also, the BCRA established the possibility for companies of the energy sector and beneficiaries of Decree No.&#160;277/2022 to subscribe dollar bills payable in pesos at zero rate (&#8220;LEDIV&#8221;) simultaneously with the liquidation of funds for the financing of imports and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">pre-financing</div> or advance payments of exports. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_125" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_126"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; Communication &#8220;A&#8221; 8,099 also clarifies that the RIGI foreign exchange benefits cannot be accumulated with other foreign exchange incentives, whether existing or to be created in the future. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Investment Promotion Regime for the Exploitation of Hydrocarbons - Decree No.&#160;929/2013 </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;13, 2024, the BCRA issued Communication &#8220;A&#8221; 8,155 that allows exporters that have a project included in the Investment Promotion Regime for the Exploitation of Hydrocarbons established by Decree No.&#160;929/2013 to obtain compliance before the financial entity for the part of the export permit that is covered by &#8220;Certificate Decree 929/2013&#8221; issued under the provisions of Resolution No.&#160;26/2023 of the SE. <td style="width:2%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.</div></div></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL; text-align: justify; line-height: normal;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </div></div></td></tr></table></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136338105_136"><div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div><div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.i) Decree of Necessity and Urgency (&#8220;DNU&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) No.&#160;70/2023 </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On December&#160;21, 2023, Decree No.&#160;70/2023 was published in the BO, declaring the state of public emergency in economic, financial, fiscal, administrative, pension, tariff, health, and social matters until December&#160;31, 2025. This decree repeals, introduces, and/or amends certain laws. The main measures established include the following: (i)&#160;reforming the structures of existing subsidies in order to ensure that final users have access to basic and essential electricity and natural gas consumption; (ii)&#160;calculating the cost of basic consumption based on the tariffs of each supply point; (iii)&#160;defining mechanisms related to the allocation of subsidies and their collection by users; (iv)&#160;amending the LGS and Law No.&#160;23,696 (&#8220;State Reform Law&#8221;) to establish that no prerogatives or advantages of public law will be granted to companies in which the National Government is a shareholder; (v)&#160;amending Law No.&#160;20,680 (&#8220;Supply Law&#8221;) which granted the Ministry of Economy&#8217;s Secretariat of Commerce the power to impose regulations and sanctions related to the supply and distribution of goods; and (vi)&#160;repealing Decree No.&#160;1,060/2000 which set maximum deadlines to contracts for the exclusive supply of fuels signed between oil and gas companies and gas stations and limited to <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:MaximumPercentageOfPermissibleInterestsInGasStations" contextRef="PAsOn12_21_2023_DecreeOfNecessityAndUrgencyDNUByItsAcronyminSpanishNo702023MemberYPFStatutoryActAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120423">40</ix:nonFraction>% the interest of the former in the networks of gas stations commercializing the brands of their property. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Although the DNU No.&#160;70/2023 needs to be debated and ratified by at least one of the chambers of the National Congress, its provisions are effective since December&#160;29, 2023, except for some provisions that have been subject to precautionary measures that suspended their validity. On March&#160;14, 2024, the Chamber of Senators of the National Congress rejected the Decree No.&#160;70/2023. As of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements, is pending to be considered by the Chamber of Deputies of the National Congress, and it is not possible to anticipate the evolution of the modifications set out in such DNU nor the new measures that might be announced nor its impacts. </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.j) Law of Bases and Starting Points for the Freedom of Argentines No.&#160;27,742 (&#8220;Bases Law&#8221;) and Regulatory Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 (&#8220;Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024&#8221;) </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On July&#160;8, 2024, the Bases Law was published in the BO, which introduces several amendments to the Argentine legal framework including, among others: (i)&#160;the declaration of emergency in administrative, economic, financial and energy matters for a term of 1 year; (ii)&#160;the administrative reorganization of the National State; (iii)&#160;the privatization of certain companies and corporations wholly or majority owned by the National State; (iv)&#160;amendments to the Administrative Procedures Law No.&#160;19,549; (v) amendments in the energy and oil and gas matters (see Notes 36.a.1), 36.b.1) and 36.c.1)); (vi) the creation of the RIGI to encourage large investments with tax, customs and exchange benefits, guaranteeing legal certainty and the protection of acquired rights (see Note 36.e)); and (vii)&#160;a labor and union reform. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">On November&#160;28, 2024, Decree No.&#160;1,057/2024 was published in the BO, which regulated various aspects of the Bases Law. See Notes 36.a.1), 36.b.1) and 36.c.1). </div><div style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">36.k) CNV Regulatory Framework </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Information requirements as Settlement and Clearing Agent and Trading Agent</div> </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As of the date of issuance of these consolidated financial statements, the Company is registered in the CNV under the category &#8220;Settlement and Clearing Agent and Trading Agent - Direct Participant&#8221;, record No.&#160;549. Considering the Company&#8217;s business and the CNV rules, the Company will not, under any circumstance, offer brokerage services to third parties for transactions in markets under the jurisdiction of the CNV, and it will also not open operating accounts to third parties to issue orders and trade in markets under the jurisdiction of the CNV. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In accordance with the regulations to the CNV, the Company is subject to the provisions of Section&#160;5 c), Chapter II, Title VII of the regulations to the CNV, &#8220;Settlement and Clearing Agent - Direct Participant&#8221;. In this respect, as set forth in Section&#160;13, Title VII, Chapter II, of the CNV rules, as of December&#160;31, 2024, the equity of the Company exceeds the minimum equity required by such rules. </div></ix:continuation></div></div><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/><div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div></div></div></div> <div><div><div style="line-height:normal;display: inline;"><div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto">

EMPLOYEE BENEFIT PLANS AND SIMILAR OBLIGATIONS </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Retirement plan </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Effective March&#160;1, 1995, the Group has established a retirement plan, through which it makes contributions to a mutual fund for an amount equivalent to the amount contributed by each adhering member, between <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfSalaryContributionToMutualFundRetirementPlan" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120723">3</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:PercentageOfSalaryContributionToMutualFundRetirementPlan" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120724">10</ix:nonFraction>% of their monthly compensation, and has no legal or implied obligation to make additional contributions in the event that the mutual fund does not have sufficient assets to meet the benefits. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The plan members will receive from the Group the contributed funds before retirement only in the case of voluntary termination under certain circumstances, dismissal without cause or in case of death or incapacity. The Group has the right to discontinue this plan at any time, without incurring termination costs. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The amount charged to expense related to the Retirement plan was <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_RetirementPlanMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120725">4</ix:nonFraction>, <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2023To12_31_2023_RetirementPlanMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120726">3</ix:nonFraction> and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2022To12_31_2022_RetirementPlanMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120727">4</ix:nonFraction> for the years ended December&#160;31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Short-term benefit programs </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The Group has short-term benefit cash payment programs applicable to certain employees. These programs are mainly based on the fulfillment of VPs and unit objectives and may be increased based on individual performance. They are calculated considering the remuneration of each employee, the number of salaries assigned per salary category and certain key factors related to the fulfillment of these objectives. As of 2024, a new variable compensation program based on the Group&#8217;s results (&#8220;CVR&#8221;, by its acronym in Spanish) was implemented, to be paid whenever these results are positive. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The amount charged to expense related to the short-term benefit programs was <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_PerformanceBonusProgramsAndPerformanceEvaluationMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120728">154</ix:nonFraction>, <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2023To12_31_2023_PerformanceBonusProgramsAndPerformanceEvaluationMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120729">111</ix:nonFraction> and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense" contextRef="P01_01_2022To12_31_2022_PerformanceBonusProgramsAndPerformanceEvaluationMemberifrsfullDefinedBenefitPlansAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120730">122</ix:nonFraction> for the years ended December&#160;31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Share-based benefit plans </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">From the fiscal year 2013 the Company has decided to implement a share-based benefit plan aimed at aligning the performance of certain executive-level employees, managers and key or critical technical knowledgeable personnel, with the objectives of the strategic plan of the Company.
