This supplement has no significant effects. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Also, it was defined that the 2021-2024 Plan would be paid in cash. Such change in the conditions of the plan does not have any significant effects. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">In April 2024, the Company adopted the &#8220;Value Generation Plan&#8221;, which is a long-term remuneration program for eligible members of management of YPF with the objective of incentivizing extraordinary results in the long term and retaining key employees. Under this plan, the Company granted <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:NumberOfShareOptionsGrantedInSharebasedPaymentArrangement" contextRef="P04_01_2024To04_30_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_shares" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120743">4.6</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million performance stock appreciation rights (&#8220;PSARs&#8221;) to plan participants comprising key employees of the Company. The PSARs provide beneficiaries the opportunity to receive an award to be settled in cash equivalent to the appreciation in the value of the common shares of the Company over a specified period of time. The amount to be paid upon exercise is the difference between the per share base price determined by the plan and the per share market value of the Company&#8217;s common shares as of the exercise date. <ix:nonNumeric name="ifrs-full:DescriptionOfMaximumTermOfOptionsGrantedForSharebasedPaymentArrangement" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" id="ixv-120744">The PSARs expire five years after their grant and begin to vest in the third year, subject to the fulfillment of certain conditions, including performance milestones related to the price of the Company&#8217;s common shares ranging from a minimum of US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageSharePrice2019" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_BottomOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_per_Share" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120745">30</ix:nonFraction> per common share up to US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageSharePrice2019" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_per_Share" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120746">60</ix:nonFraction> per common share.</ix:nonNumeric> The beneficiaries of the PSARs are also required to remain in the Company for <ix:nonNumeric name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageRemainingContractualLifeOfOutstandingShareOptions2019" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="ixv-120747">three years</ix:nonNumeric> from the granting of the plan. The PSARs granted by the Company have a base price of US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageSharePrice2019" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_per_Share" decimals="2" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120748">16.17</ix:nonFraction> per share, resulting in a weighted average fair value of US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageExercisePriceOfShareOptionsGrantedInSharebasedPaymentArrangement2019" contextRef="P04_30_2024To04_30_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_per_Share" decimals="2" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120749">8.75</ix:nonFraction> per PSAR as of the granting date. The Value Generation Plan was approved by the Compensation and Nomination Committee of the Company with the support of a management consulting firm (Mercer) which advised on its design and implementation. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">As of December&#160;31, 2024, there are <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:NumberOfShareOptionsGrantedInSharebasedPaymentArrangement" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_shares" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120750">4.6</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million number of PSARs outstanding with and a weighted average fair value of US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:WeightedAverageSharePrice2019" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD_per_Share" decimals="1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120751">28.6</ix:nonFraction> per PSARs. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">PSARs expense is determined based on the grant-date fair value of the awards. Fair value is calculated using Monte Carlo simulation model, which requires the input of highly subjective assumptions, including the fair value of the Company&#8217;s shares, expected term and risk-free interest rate. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The amount charged to expense in relation with Value Generation Plan was <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsInWhichGoodsOrServicesReceivedDidNotQualifyForRecognitionAsAssets" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_ValueGenerationPlanMemberifrsfullTypesOfSharebasedPaymentArrangementsAxis" unitRef="Unit_USD" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120752">33</ix:nonFraction>, for the fiscal year ended December&#160;31, 2024. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Note 2.b.11) describes the accounting policies for share-based benefit plans. Repurchases of treasury shares are disclosed in Note 31. </div></ix:continuation> </div></div><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_7" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_8"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></div></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_8" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_9"><ix:exclude><hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/></ix:exclude></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_9" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_10"><ix:exclude> <div style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 1.67em; margin-bottom: 1.67em;font-weight: bold;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div></div> </ix:exclude></ix:continuation> <div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><ix:continuation id="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_10" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136337963_11"><ix:exclude>

margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:center">S - 1 </div> <div style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</div> <ix:nonNumeric name="ifrs-full:DisclosureOfConsolidatedAndSeparateFinancialStatementsExplanatory" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024" escape="true" continuedAt="TextSelection_136338104" id="ixv-87572"> <div style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;">SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION ON OIL AND GAS PRODUCING ACTIVITIES (UNAUDITED) </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The following information is presented in accordance with the Accounting Standards Codification (&#8220;ASC&#8221;) No.&#160;932 &#8220;Extractive Activities - Oil and Gas&#8221;, as amended by Accounting Standards Update (&#8220;ASU&#8221;) 2010 - 03 &#8220;Oil and Gas Reserves. Estimation and Disclosures&#8221;, issued by the Financial Accounting Standards Board (&#8220;FASB&#8221;) in January 2010. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Oil and gas reserves </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Proved oil and gas reserves are those quantities of oil and gas which by analysis of geoscience and engineering data, can be estimated with reasonable certainty to be economically producible (from a given date forward, from known reservoirs, and under existing economic conditions, operating methods and government regulations) prior to the time at which contracts providing the right to operate expire, unless evidence indicates that renewal is reasonably certain, regardless of whether deterministic or probabilistic methods are used for the estimation. The project to extract the hydrocarbons must have commenced or the operator must be reasonably certain that it will commence the project within reasonable time. In some cases, substantial investments in new wells and related facilities may be required to recover proved reserves. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Information on net proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024, 2023 and 2022 was calculated in accordance with the SEC rules and FASB ASC 932 rules. Accordingly, crude oil prices used to determine reserves were calculated for crude oils of different quality produced by the Company. Consequently, to calculate our net proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024, the Company considered, according to the SEC rules and FASB ASC 932 rules, the unweighted average realized price of crude oils for each month within the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">12-month</div> period ended December&#160;31, 2024, which refers to the domestic crude oil prices adjusted by each different quality produced by the Company. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The reported reserves contained in this annual report include only our proved reserves and do not include probable reserves or possible reserves. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Additionally, since there are no benchmark market natural gas prices available in Argentina, the Company considered the <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">12-month</div> period average ended December&#160;31, 2024 of domestic market realized prices according to the SEC rules and FASB ASC 932 rules, and the prices of contracts awarded to YPF under the Plan GasAr 2020-2024 and the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 for certain blocks in certain basins, which will be in effect until their corresponding termination dates. See Note 36.d.1) to the Audited Consolidated Financial Statements. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Notwithstanding the foregoing, commodity prices have fluctuated significantly in recent years. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Net reserves are defined as that portion of the gross reserves attributable to the interest of YPF after deducting interests owned by third parties. In determining net reserves, the Group excludes from its reported reserves royalties owed to others, whether payable in cash or in kind, where the royalty owner has a direct interest in the underlying production and is able to make lifting and sales arrangements independently. By contrast, to the extent that royalty payments required to be made to a third party, whether payable in cash or in kind, are a financial obligation, or are substantially equivalent to a production or severance tax, the related reserves are not excluded from the reported reserves despite the fact that such payments are referred to as royalties under local regulations. The same methodology is followed in reporting our production amounts. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Natural gas reserves exclude the gaseous equivalent of liquids expected to be removed from the natural gas on concessions and leases, at field facilities and at natural gas processing plants. These liquids are included in net proved reserves of natural gas liquids (&#8220;NGLs&#8221;). </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Technology used in establishing proved reserves additions </div></div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">YPF&#8217;s estimated proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024, are based on estimates generated through the integration of available and appropriate data, utilizing well-established technologies that have been demonstrated in the field to yield repeatable and consistent results. Data used in these integrated assessments include information obtained directly from the subsurface via wellbore, such as well logs, reservoir core samples, fluid samples, static and dynamic pressure information, production test data, and surveillance and performance information. The data utilized also include subsurface information obtained through indirect measurements, including high quality <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">2-D</div> and <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">3-D</div> seismic data, calibrated with available well control. Where applicable, geological outcrops information was also utilized. The tools used to interpret and integrate all this data included both proprietary and commercial software for reservoir modeling, simulation and data analysis. In some circumstances, where appropriate analog reservoir models are available, reservoir parameters from these analog models were used to increase the reliability of our reserves estimates. </div> </ix:nonNumeric></div></div> <ix:continuation id="TextSelection_136338104" continuedAt="TextSelectionAppend_136338104_1"><ix:exclude><div style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom: 0pt; font-size: 9pt; font-family: ARIAL;"><div style="font-weight:bold;display:inline;"><ix:exclude>SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION ON OIL AND GAS PRODUCING ACTIVITIES (UNAUDITED) (cont.)</ix:exclude> </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><div style="text-decoration: underline; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">Reserves sensitivity </div></div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The impact of negative future fluctuations of oil and gas prices, and operating costs, in the estimated proved reserves, may be captured through a reserves sensitivity estimate. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">If natural gas prices used in our <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">year-end</div> reserve estimates decreased by <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncreaseDecreaseInEstimatedReserve" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_NaturalGasMemberifrsfullClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120859">10</ix:nonFraction>%, our total proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024 would decrease by approximately <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncreaseDecreaseInTotalProvedReserve" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_NaturalGasMemberifrsfullClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120860">0.6</ix:nonFraction>%. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Furthermore, assuming all other factors remain constant, if costs used in our <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">year-end</div> reserve estimates increased by <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncreaseDecreaseInEstimatedReserve" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_CrudeOilAndNaturalGasMemberifrsfullClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120861">10</ix:nonFraction>% for crude oil and natural gas, our total proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024 would decrease by approximately <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncreaseDecreaseInTotalProvedReserve" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_CrudeOilAndNaturalGasMemberifrsfullClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120862">3.1</ix:nonFraction>%. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">However, if we combine the three mentioned effects, our total proved reserves as of December&#160;31, 2024 would decrease by approximately <ix:nonFraction name="ypf:IncreaseDecreaseInTotalProvedReserve" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024_TopOfRangeMemberifrsfullRangeAxis" unitRef="Unit_pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="ixv-120863">6</ix:nonFraction>%. </div><div style="margin-top:6pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">12-month</div> period average ended December&#160;31, 2024 of domestic market realized prices according to the SEC rules and FASB ASC 932 rules, and the prices of contracts awarded to YPF under the Plan GasAr 2020-2024 and the Plan GasAr 2023-2028 for certain areas, which will be in effect until their corresponding termination dates. See Note 36.d.1) to the Audited Consolidated Financial Statements. </div> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">Future production costs include the estimated expenditures related to production of the proved reserves, plus any production taxes without consideration of future inflation. Future development costs include the estimated costs of drilling development wells and installation of production facilities, plus the net costs associated with dismantling and abandonment of wells, assuming <div style="white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">year-end</div> costs continue without consideration of future inflation. Future income taxes were determined by applying statutory rates to future cash inflows less future production costs and less tax depreciation of the properties involved. The present value was determined by applying a discount rate of 10% per year to the annual future net cash flows. </div> <ix:nonNumeric name="ypf:DisclosureOfDiscountedFutureNetCashFlowFromOilAndGasExplanatory" contextRef="P01_01_2024To12_31_2024" escape="true" id="ixv-99525"> <div style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL;text-align:justify">The standardized measure does not purport to be an estimate of the fair market value of the Group&#8217;s proved reserves. An estimate of fair value would also take into account, among other things, the expected recovery of reserves in excess of proved reserves, anticipated changes in future prices and costs and a discount factor representative of the time value of money and the risks inherent in producing oil and gas. </div> <div style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</div>
